turγaγ̇ud-i: turγaγ̇ — bodyguard, guard, follower (Ming 護衞 'guards'); plural -d; accusative -i, 'the guards (object)' (noun + plural + case; Ming 護衞(每)行) [護衞(每)行] · also turγaγ — day guard (an inference; Ming 散班 '(scattered) shift'); plural -d; accusative -i, 'the day guards (object)' (noun + plural + case) [散班的(每行)]
muqali-jin: Muqali — Muqali, a man's name; genitive -jin (after a vowel), 'of Muqali' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
buqa: Buqa — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名] · also buqa, 'bull' (Ming 强牛 'strong ox'), a common word and not the name, as in γurban buqa, 'three bulls'
dodai: Dodai — a man's name (personal name) [人名]
žürčedei-jin: Žürčedei — Jürchedei, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Jürchedei' (personal name + case) [人名的]
arγai-qasar: Arγai-Qasar — Arqai-Qasar, a man's name (personal name; Arγai 'Arqai' with Qasar) [人名]
baγ̇atud-i: baγ̇atur — hero, brave warrior; plural -d; accusative -i, 'the warriors (object)' (noun + plural + case; Ming 勇士每 行) [勇士(每)行]
üdür: üdür — day [日] · also 'daytime, midday' (Ming 晝), in üdür düli naran 'the noon sun'
qadqulduγ̇an: qadqul- — to fight (stem read from the Ming); -ldu-, joint action, 'each other'; -γan, a participle (reading uncertain) 'fighting one another' (verb, reciprocal, participle) [厮殺︀的]
baižu: bai- — to stand, stay; converb -žu, 'standing' (verb, converb) [立着]
baγ̇atud: baγatur — brave man, hero; plural -d, 'brave men' (noun + plural; the -ur drops before -d) [勇士每]
iregsed: ire- — to come; participle -gsed, 'those who have come' (verb, past participle, plural) [來了]
qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇] · also before the thing counted: qojar sumu, 'two arrows' (Ming 兩隻 'two (arrows)')
γol: γol — spine, back-ridge (noun) [脊梁] · also 'centre, main body' of an army (Ming 中軍), in jeke γol 'the great main body'
bolun: bol- — to become, to be; converb -un, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming 做了) [做了] · also 'when, at the time' (Ming 時) · also in neġükü bolun, 'when setting off, on starting' (the participle neġükü + bolun; Ming 做呵 'when doing'; uncertain) · also bol- 'to become' with converb -un in the sense 'together, as one' (Ming 共) · also bol- with the Ming 上頭 'on account of, therefore' [上頭] · also the Ming 欲做 'wishing to do, about to' (uncertain) [欲做] · also bol- 'to cease, stop' + converb -un (Ming 住) · also dobtulqu bolun 'about to charge, bent on charging' (Ming 要 'wish to'; compare bailduqu bolun) · also with Ming 做 'becoming' (plain converb, ködölkün bolun)
